outcome: severe intraventricular hemorrhage (grade III or IV)
cohort: This study included 1587 preterm infants born before 29 weeks of gestational age in France who were intubated at birth, with 398 neonates in each of the matched early and delayed extubation groups.
finding: Early extubation was not associated with an increased proportion of severe intraventricular hemorrhages in preterm infants.
